name: KDA without value embeddings
tagline: The KDA control for the KDA + MLA-NoPE hybrid.
description: Pure Kimi Delta Attention with every value-embedding table and gate removed, independently calibrated within the shared budget. Comparing it with KDA separates the effect of value embeddings; comparing it with the KDA + MLA-NoPE hybrid separates the effect of the latent-attention layers.
paperTitle: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
mechanism: 23 KDA layers with the linear family's decay gate, output gate and causal convolution
Value embeddings and their gates removed
limitations: A paired control, not a new method. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
